prompt: Your manager asks you directly what happened after a customer complained that your colleague snapped at them. You saw it happen and your colleague is a friend. What is the most honest and fair response?

options.text: Lie and say you saw nothing, because you do not get a friend in trouble
Describe the incident but add other complaints about your colleague to make sure action is taken
Refuse to answer at all and walk away from the conversation
Describe only what you actually saw, factually and without piling on, and leave space for your colleague to give their side

explanation: Sticking to what you witnessed is honest to your manager and fair to your friend. Lying protects neither of you for long, and adding extra complaints turns a factual account into a pile-on.
